object: anion-pillared MOF sorbent for C2H2/C2H4 separation
problem: How to maximize trace C2H2 binding affinity and selectivity over C2H4 in a physisorbent.
mechanism_or_method: Programmed multi-site fluorine binding in anion-pillared MOF ZJU-300a, confirmed by gas-loaded structures and breakthrough tests.
limitation: Lab-scale synthesis and breakthrough tests only; scale-up and long-term stability not addressed in abstract.

problem: How to make amine-functionalized adsorbents efficient and cyclically stable for CO2 capture.
mechanism_or_method: Atom-level design placing each PEI molecule in MIL-101 cages coordinated to Cr sites, preventing carbamate dehydration.
limitation: Lab-scale cycling only; performance under humid flue gas and at scale not shown.

problem: How to 3D print dense piezoceramic elements with near-pristine properties for miniaturized cavitation transducers.
mechanism_or_method: Optimized piezoceramic printing and processing plus integrated printed packaging producing complex-geometry transducers with d33 of 583 pC/N.
limitation: Cavitation shown only in millimeter channels; in vivo intravascular delivery not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Enables printed free-form piezoelectric transducers instead of machined flat elements.

problem: How to get high charge generation with low surface wear in solid-solid triboelectric interfaces.
mechanism_or_method: Use metallic glass as a triboelectric layer, whose low atomic density and lack of grain boundaries raise triboelectrification efficiency and wear resistance.
limitation: Lab devices; long-term durability and real-use conditions not reported in abstract.
decision_relevance: Suggests metallic glass as wear-resistant contact material for TENG design.

problem: How to make hydrogels whose thermal deformation and mechanics can be trained in either direction and do active work.
mechanism_or_method: Dual network of two thermoresponsive polymers whose volumetric response is enhanced or reduced by training above a threshold temperature.
limitation: Thermal training is slow and demonstrated only on small lab actuators.

object: hierarchical conductive MOF films for ammonia sensing
problem: How to speed up interfacial gas mass transfer on porous solid films despite the no-slip boundary condition.
mechanism_or_method: In-situ transformation of MOF films into hierarchical c-MOF films with hollow inner voids that raise gas permeability.
limitation: Sensor tested at room temperature in lab; selectivity and long-term drift not stated.

object: polynorbornene and polyimide dielectrics for capacitors
problem: How to find polymer dielectrics with both high energy density and high thermal stability at 85-200 C.
mechanism_or_method: AI-driven chemical structure generation and property prediction combined with polymer chemistry, followed by synthesis and capacitor testing.
limitation: Lab-scale films; manufacturability and long-term reliability at temperature need validation.

object: wrinkled MXene metamaterial coated LCE fiber actuators
problem: How to maximize light-to-heat conversion in densely stacked MXene for photo-driven actuators.
mechanism_or_method: Superlattice of alternating MXene and organic layers lowers refractive index; coated on LCE fibers via dip-coating for light actuation.
limitation: Lab demonstrations; durability over many cycles and in ambient light not detailed.

object: single-crystal high-entropy alloy surfaces for ORR electrocatalysis
problem: How to relate atomic-level surface structure of high-entropy alloys to oxygen reduction activity.
mechanism_or_method: Vacuum synthesis of epitaxial Pt/Cantor alloy layers on single-crystal Pt as a model platform with catalytic evaluation.
limitation: Model single-crystal surfaces may not represent practical nanoparticle catalysts.

problem: How to get fast autonomous self-healing and pressure sensing simultaneously in aquatic environments.
mechanism_or_method: Molecular engineering with hydrophobic C-F groups, hydrolytic boronate ester bonds and ions inspired by cephalopod suckers.
limitation: Demonstrated on small lab devices; long-term underwater durability not reported.

object: 316L stainless steel in powder-fusion additive manufacturing
problem: How can feedstock powder size control grain morphology and the columnar-to-equiaxed transition in metal AM.
mechanism_or_method: Powder-size driven melt pool engineering exploiting particle-size dependent powder-flow preheating and powder-bed thermophysical properties in DED and PBF.
limitation: Shown for 316L only; transfer to other alloys and machines unverified.
decision_relevance: Choose powder size distribution to tune grain structure without added cost.

object: high-entropy alloy element selection via text mining
problem: How to select elements for new ultrahigh-entropy alloys using knowledge from scientific literature.
mechanism_or_method: Context similarity of chemical elements from text-mining models trained on 6.4 million abstracts, used to screen 2.6 million candidates.
limitation: Candidate alloys are not experimentally validated in the abstract.
decision_relevance: Prioritizes lightweight HEA compositions for experimental testing.

object: autonomous vehicle safety validation under rare events
problem: How to ensure deep-learning autonomous vehicle safety given rarity of safety-critical events in high-dimensional spaces.
mechanism_or_method: Perspective identifying three potential approaches to address the curse of rarity.
limitation: Perspective without new empirical validation.
decision_relevance: Guides choice of AV safety testing and training strategies.

object: cement carbonation CO2 uptake and radiative forcing
problem: How large is the true climate benefit of cement carbonation given slow uptake timing.
mechanism_or_method: Global carbonation modelling 1930-2015 combined with dynamic cumulative radiative forcing analysis and sensitivity to decarbonization strategies.
limitation: Relies on model assumptions about carbonation rates and uptake; no new measurements.
decision_relevance: Lowers credit assigned to carbonation in cement decarbonization planning.

problem: How to build ultrathin selective membranes combining precise molecular sieving and catalytic self-cleaning.
mechanism_or_method: Interfacial polymerization of porous organic cages into crosslinked polycage layers, impregnated with Pd nanoclusters.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; scalability and long-term fouling behavior not shown.

problem: How to raise the low fracture toughness of superhard high-entropy carbides.
mechanism_or_method: In-situ metastable tetragonal and monoclinic ZrO2 particles in (WTaNbZrTi)C matrix that toughen via transformation and crack shielding.
limitation: Toughness of 5.89 MPa m1/2 still modest; shown for one composition.
decision_relevance: Supports transformation toughening for ceramics in harsh mechanical service.

object: covalent adaptable network shape memory polymers for 4D printing
problem: How to get reconfigurable 4D printing with strong thermomechanical properties in CAN shape memory polymers.
mechanism_or_method: Mechanically robust CAN-SMP resin with high Tg and modulus, printed by DLP for multiple reconfigurations.
limitation: Lab demonstrations; reconfiguration fatigue limits and scale not detailed.

problem: How has climate change affected extreme power shortage events of wind-solar systems worldwide from 1980 to 2022.
mechanism_or_method: Hourly reanalysis climate data used to define and trend extreme shortage events and attribute them to compound wind and solar drought.
limitation: Uses reanalysis-derived simulated generation rather than measured grid outputs.
decision_relevance: Informs reliability planning and storage sizing for wind-solar systems.

problem: How to get high contraction ratio, force and dynamic response simultaneously in pneumatic artificial muscles.
mechanism_or_method: X-crossing mechanism directly converting linear actuator-axis motion, giving 92.9% contraction ratio and high specific power.
limitation: Bench characterization and demos only; fatigue life and control accuracy not detailed.
decision_relevance: Offers faster, stronger pneumatic actuator option for exoskeletons and jumping robots.

problem: How to embed shape actuation, sensing and locking in a robot body without bulky external equipment.
mechanism_or_method: Embedded morphing scheme with integrated actuation, sensing and locking, demonstrated in grippers, a quadruped and an amphibious robot.
limitation: Lab prototypes; robustness in uncontrolled environments not shown.

problem: How to combine strength, stiffness and toughness in hydrogels via high-precision structural design.
mechanism_or_method: Sequential self-assembly assisted salting out forming a crosslinked sheath and aligned nanofibril porous core.
limitation: Lab-scale specimens; durability in wet or loaded service environments not detailed.

problem: How to give wearable haptic feedback without bulky instruments and power modules.
mechanism_or_method: Triboelectric textile harvesting hand motion and driving gas breakdown discharge for localized electrical stimulation.
limitation: Prototype glove; stimulation comfort and reliability with many users not stated.

problem: How can a digital twin monitor and control a DC-DC converter and take over from a failed controller.
mechanism_or_method: Dynamic virtual replica tracking the physical converter, detecting controller failure and replacing it in real time.
limitation: Verified on a lab converter in four cases; industrial deployment untested.

object: surface charge density of triboelectric materials
problem: How to visualize and quantify surface charge on triboelectric materials in a standardized way.
mechanism_or_method: Kelvin probe surface potential with iterative regularization inversion, plus corona discharge charge tuning with a three-electrode design.
limitation: Demonstrated mainly on PTFE; generality to other materials unclear.

problem: How to achieve self-regulated continuous motion in soft robots using geometric topology.
mechanism_or_method: Knotted photo-responsive hydrogels where self-constraint prestress couples with photothermal strain and self-shadowing to drive rolling and spinning.
limitation: Small lab robots under controlled light; scalability and speed limited.

problem: How do dynamic curvature changes drive mechanotransduction and crypt morphogenesis in intestinal organoids.
mechanism_or_method: Photoinduced hydrogel cross-link exchange spatiotemporally alters curvature, revealing membrane tension, depolarization and delayed YAP localization.
limitation: In vitro organoid model; relevance to in vivo development not shown.

object: magnetic liquid metal miniature soft robot
problem: How to stably composite non-wettable Fe3O4 nanoparticles into gallium-indium liquid metal.
mechanism_or_method: Silver intermediate layer forms AgxIny intermetallics via reactive wetting, anchoring Fe3O4 for magnetic actuation.
limitation: Only ex vivo porcine stomach validation; in vivo safety unproven.

object: PBI proton exchange membranes for high-temperature fuel cells
problem: How to prevent membrane creep and phosphoric acid loss above 200 C in PBI fuel cell membranes.
mechanism_or_method: Gel-state PBI with double cross-linked 3D layered structure via polyphosphoric acid sol-gel process anchoring phosphoric acid.
limitation: Only 250-hour test at 220 C; stack-level durability unproven.

object: FDM printing of functional gradients with digital material filament
problem: How to create spatial gradients of properties using only a standard FDM printer and filaments.
mechanism_or_method: A 3D printed digital material filament of multiple base materials that blends homogeneously during extrusion to program properties.
limitation: Gradient resolution limited by extrusion blending; material pairs tested are limited.
decision_relevance: Allows low-cost functionally graded parts on commodity FDM printers.

object: triboelectric pressure sensor with water-containing elastomer
problem: How to combine high sensitivity with wide linear range in active pressure sensors.
mechanism_or_method: Water-containing triboelectric elastomer with gradient microchannels where water bridges modulate built-in field and ion-rich interface boosts sensitivity.
limitation: Liquid content stability over long use not stated in abstract.

object: eutectic high-entropy alloy under HPHT treatment
problem: How to overcome the strength-ductility trade-off in a strong but brittle eutectic high-entropy alloy.
mechanism_or_method: High-pressure high-temperature treatment forms hierarchical microstructure with coherent interfaces activating multiple deformation mechanisms.
limitation: HPHT processing limits specimen size and scalability.
decision_relevance: Suggests HPHT processing as a route to strong and ductile structural alloys.

problem: How to raise thermoelectric power conversion efficiency while suppressing brittle failure.
mechanism_or_method: Additively manufactured microlattices with cellular thermal impedance and ductile partially carbonized struts.
limitation: Efficiency described as potential; device-level durability and scale-up not shown.

object: lobed loops of liquid crystal elastomer fibers
problem: How to achieve autonomous untethered synchronized snap-through motion in soft robots.
mechanism_or_method: Curved LCE fibers buckle on a hot surface; geometrically constrained fibers in lobed loops synchronize at about 1.8 Hz.
limitation: Needs a hot surface; slow speed of about 2.4 mm/s.

problem: How to broaden reprogramming functions of mechanical metamaterials beyond mono-characteristic elements.
mechanism_or_method: Heterogeneous origami elements assembled into functional groups and rings that switch between positive and negative stiffness and Poisson's ratio.
limitation: Prototype-scale origami elements; actuation and cycling durability not addressed.

problem: How to make low-cost, drift-free, magnetically driven millirobots with high-throughput fabrication.
mechanism_or_method: Asymmetric light pattern distortion in laser-induced graphene conversion causes spontaneous twisting into helical scaffolds, nickel coated for magnetic drive.
limitation: Drug delivery shown only in simulated physiological environment, not in vivo.

problem: How to identify material type and softness with quantified modulus in one tactile sensor.
mechanism_or_method: Hemispherical triboelectric array inspired by insect campaniform sensilla producing unique output fingerprints per contacted material.
limitation: Tested on a limited set of materials in lab conditions.

problem: How to modulate ion migration in hydrogels to mimic synaptic learning and memory.
mechanism_or_method: Responsive supramolecular hybrid hydrogel where light releases mobile ions to tune conductivity, driving a robotic hand.
limitation: Proof of concept with a single device and simple optical stimuli.

problem: How can large robot swarms assemble complex shapes efficiently and adaptively.
mechanism_or_method: Mean-shift exploration where robots give up locations by moving toward the highest density of nearby unoccupied target locations.
limitation: Physical verification limited to 50 ground robots in a lab arena.

problem: How to build reconfigurable origami structures without facet deformation that depend heavily on material.
mechanism_or_method: Modular bistable rigid-origami units with elastic creases and switchable mountain-valley lines giving programmable multistable configurations.
limitation: Prototype units; actuation method for switching and load capacity not detailed.

problem: How to get an all-in-one artificial skin material with strong mechanics, self-healing, adhesion and sensing.
mechanism_or_method: Consolidated organic/metal bismuth ion architecture with hierarchical reversible noncovalent interactions.
limitation: Lab-scale sample; long-term stability and biocompatibility not detailed.

problem: How to make carbon aerogels that are both highly compressible and fatigue resistant.
mechanism_or_method: Synthesis assembling interconnected highly cross-linked carbon tubes giving near-zero Poisson's ratio and 99% recoverable strain.
limitation: Fatigue tested to 1000 cycles only; scale of production not addressed.

object: duplex stainless steel with non-metallic inclusions
problem: How to stop inclusion-induced corrosion failure in duplex stainless steels.
mechanism_or_method: Minor Nb addition forms inclusion@Z-phase core-shell structures that isolate inclusions from corrosive environments, selected by theoretical screening.
limitation: Long-term service corrosion performance in field conditions not reported.
decision_relevance: Adds Nb alloying to improve corrosion resistance of duplex steels in production.

object: China's coal chemical sector green hydrogen deployment
problem: What are the GHG mitigation potential and costs of onsite green H2 and O2 in China's coal chemical sector.
mechanism_or_method: Life-cycle assessment and techno-economic analysis of solar or wind electrolytic H2 and O2 replacing coal-based supply by province.
limitation: Projection to 2030 depends on assumed costs, technology and policy scenarios.
decision_relevance: Prioritizes provinces and power sources for green hydrogen pilot projects.

problem: How to give soft robots dynamic underwater adhesion and morphing capability.
mechanism_or_method: Resilin-like protein complexed with polyoxometalate switches between adhesive and stiff states with temperature; Fe3O4 adds photothermal and magnetic control.
limitation: Lab water tank demonstrations; protein production scale and durability not addressed.

problem: Which electronic structure features govern screw dislocation behavior and intrinsic ductility in bcc high-entropy alloys.
mechanism_or_method: First-principles calculations on nine compositions linking dislocation core, stacking fault and surface energies to bonding-state fraction and d-orbital bimodality.
limitation: Only nine compositions and ideal-supercell DFT models; no experimental validation in the abstract.
decision_relevance: Guides computational screening of ductile bcc HEA compositions.

object: zwitterionic fibrous membrane for solar desalination
problem: How to prevent salt accumulation in solar evaporators while also generating electricity.
mechanism_or_method: Aquaporin-inspired porous zwitterionic fibrous membrane with porphyrin conjugated microporous polymer photothermal layer coupled to a thermoelectric module.
limitation: Indoor simulated sunlight tests; outdoor long-term operation not shown.

problem: How to realize complete sense-decide-act loops within origami materials.
mechanism_or_method: Flexible bistable mechanisms combined with conductive thermal artificial muscles form multiplexed switches, logic gates and memory bits.
limitation: Thermal actuation is slow; demonstrations are small-scale prototypes.

object: helical fibrous muscle tubular soft actuators
problem: How to give tubular soft actuators many designable degrees of freedom and morphing modes.
mechanism_or_method: Programmable filament winding to build helical artificial fibrous muscle architectures with locally tunable orientation, giving 11 morphing modes.
limitation: Lab-scale photoresponsive demonstrations; force output and response speed not highlighted.

object: dielectric elastomer soft robots with chiral-lattice feet
problem: How to achieve dexterous locomotion with direction changes in small electrically driven soft robots.
mechanism_or_method: Dielectric elastomer artificial muscle with reconfigurable chiral-lattice foot enabling forward, backward and circular motion under a single voltage input.
limitation: Tethered high-voltage drive on flat lab surfaces.

object: end-linked star polymer elastomer with strain-induced crystallization
problem: How to raise strain-induced crystallinity and stretchability beyond limits set by trapped entanglements.
mechanism_or_method: End-linking and deswelling star polymers yields low-defect networks without trapped entanglements, reaching up to 50% crystallinity.
limitation: Lab synthesis of model networks; processability and cost at scale not addressed.

problem: How to make flexible, large-aperture, lead-free ultrasound probes cheaply for medical use.
mechanism_or_method: Transducer-on-foil technology from thermal embossing of a piezoelectric polymer, integrated in an endoscope probe and blood pressure sensor.
limitation: Imaging shown on tissue-mimicking phantom, not clinical patients.

problem: How to combine exceptional mechanical properties with dexterous actuation in artificial muscles.
mechanism_or_method: Phase-change polymer with ferromagnetic particles allowing stiffness switching and multimodal motion by laser heating and magnetic field.
limitation: Needs external laser and magnetic field; response speed and cycle life not stated.

problem: How to form percolated MOF pathways in mixed matrix membranes without losing mechanical properties.
mechanism_or_method: Demixing two immiscible polyimides so MOF particles partition into one domain, creating a percolated network at 19 wt% loading.
limitation: Pure-gas lab tests; mixed-gas, aging and scale-up behavior not reported.

problem: How can plant proteins be made to lubricate well and reduce astringent friction.
mechanism_or_method: Physically cross-linked plant protein microgels tested by biomimetic tongue-like tribology, AFM, rheology and numerical modelling.
limitation: Biomimetic surface tribology only; no sensory panel validation in the abstract.

problem: How to weld AA2024 without hot cracking while keeping high joint strength.
mechanism_or_method: Zr-core-Al-shell filler wire with laser beam oscillation to promote fine equiaxed grains during solidification.
limitation: Demonstrated on AA2024 lab welds; fatigue and corrosion of joints not reported.
decision_relevance: Use Zr-core filler wire to weld crack-prone 2000-series aluminium.

object: community V2X battery circular economy and lifecycle carbon
problem: How can battery lifecycle carbon intensity be quantified and driven to zero in electricity-driven communities.
mechanism_or_method: Lifecycle carbon quantification with V2X interaction, cascade utilization and circular economy scenarios across climate regions.
limitation: Scenario-based modelling of a community; results depend on assumed parameters.
decision_relevance: Informs battery reuse and V2X investment pathways for carbon-neutral communities.

object: pyrocarbon sorbent for gold recovery from e-waste leachate
problem: How to recover gold selectively and cheaply from e-waste leachate.
mechanism_or_method: Alginate-derived pyrocarbon whose aromatic structures donate electrons for stepwise reduction via gold-chlorine clusters.
limitation: Tested on CPU leachates at lab scale; industrial scale-up unproven.

object: ultra-thin multimodal dielectric elastomer soft robots
problem: How to build soft robots thin enough for narrow gaps that also move across solid, liquid and aerial domains.
mechanism_or_method: Dual-actuation sandwich structure with tunable Poisson's ratio tensioning mechanism driven by dielectric elastomers, giving linear and undulating gaits.
limitation: Slow speed and high-voltage tethered operation; field inspection not demonstrated.

object: Turing-structured COF membranes for organic solvent nanofiltration
problem: How to control stacking and sieving in covalent organic framework membranes.
mechanism_or_method: Tannic acid heterogeneous nucleation modifies reaction-diffusion assembly, forming labyrinthine Turing-patterned COF films with uniform pores.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; long-term stability and scale-up not shown.

object: dislocations in wire-laser DED 316L stainless steel
problem: How do dislocations evolve during rapid solidification and cooling in additive manufacturing.
mechanism_or_method: Operando synchrotron X-ray diffraction on wire-laser DED combined with multi-physics simulation, in-situ neutron diffraction and electron microscopy.
limitation: Semi-quantitative dislocation density; requires synchrotron access; one alloy and process.
decision_relevance: Informs process control and qualification of AM parts via dislocation evolution.
